module_name: Camera adapter: single media file (incoming / FTP folder)
input: One media file that no card index describes, under a selected folder that is no card of a known camera (v5 'Kamera / FTP incoming', scan_media_files). Video extensions of v5 MEDIA_EXTENSIONS without audio-only ones.
output: One group (the file is the original and its own evidence, no proxy) and a camera record that knows only the media URI; sufficiency is always NeedsProbe, so the record is completed by one probe in Ingest. Nothing is taken from the file name.
specification: AGENTS.md section 18 (2026-10-09 single files); QNC_v5 qnc-host/src/ingest/scanner.rs scan_media_files, media/resolve.rs MEDIA_EXTENSIONS
